scope: ordinary book learning with certification and persistent expansion progress; learned IDs retain pet-skills-v1 state format
provenance: client_verified identities, protection count, extra failure points, thresholds and wire; guide_supported chance table; designed missing server state machine

generation.provenance: designed for explicitly new pets only

thresholds: original item.cpetskillsuccessconfig.progress keyed by current learned-skill count; original UI verified; guarantee semantics remain designed

probability.provenance: guide_supported: official PC probability disclosure published2017-06-14; exact match to1.6.1 unproved; supersedes temporary flat250/1000 design

certification.selection: optional exact current learned distinct IDs; selected ID requires corresponding certificate; no-certificate empty pet may learn its first skill, empty pets cannot waste certificates

failure_progress.provenance: base1 designed; extra1/3 from original item text; only eligible new-family expansion failure below current blood-color cap accumulates

guarantee: designed: current points at positive threshold before an eligible new-family attempt force append; append resets0; reaching threshold through this failure benefits the next attempt
replacement: designed: preserve order; fixed server replacement draw modulo unprotected positions; when all protected and expansion fails, valid attempt consumes materials and increases progress but keeps learned IDs
upgrade: in-place same-family upgrade; protected target rejected before consumption; upgrades and actions already at color cap leave progress unchanged
consumption: designed: valid attempt consumes one book and one of each supplied certificate, including protected-all failure; invalid/duplicate/weaker intent consumes nothing; failed bound-book attempt does not bind until an actual learning succeeds
legacy: unknown progress stays unknown; explicit one-time historical points required; old skill state and v1 receipts readable, no retroactive progress; temporary v2 algorithm was not published/deployed
transaction: book/certificate debit, skill version, progress, optional pet binding, asset revision and receipt in current role lease transaction; preencode current replies before commit
